info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Parking Reservations Checkouts-v3-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservations Checkout Retrieval API allows users to access and review the details of parking reservations that have been checked out. This endpoint provides vital information about reservations, including the associated vehicles, duration, and checkout times. It's designed for parking management systems and applications where stakeholders can track active reservations for better resource allocation. Developers typically leverage this API to integrate reservation data into dashboards or reporting tools.

get.summary: Retrieve the checkout details for reservations.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to obtain detailed information regarding the checkout process for their reservations. It ensures that all necessary data is available to complete the reservation checkout seamlessly.
